title: Topic 6.3: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE USE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 6.3: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use
2. Practise Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use in the examples.
2. Explain Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use
2. Practise Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
